change: Shared compiled Script entries (stage 4). Script, indirect/direct eval, ShadowRealm and Function-body entries whose lowered modules differ only in plain string-literal data share one published native entry. The lowered module's literal values (untyped const initializers and identifier assignment values inside execute; never templates, directives, RegExp sources, property keys, names, operators or helper arguments) are rewritten to getScriptLiteral($script, i) reads from a per-parse literal table on the ScriptRecord. The cache key is the complete canonical syntax of the abstracted module (every syntax field except spans and node hashes; syntaxKey/syntaxKeyHash/syntaxKeyMatches) plus the entry shape (script / indirect-eval / shadow-realm / function-body / direct-eval:<flags>:<privateEnvironment>:<fieldInitializer>). Entries are bounded LRU (256 in Test262 images), digest-bucketed and verified in place without building a key per evaluation. Managed contract caches are compile-scoped so no previous graph stays live across evaluations.

keyCompleteness.abstractedLiterals: Only untyped const string initializers and string values assigned to identifiers inside execute; literals feeding early errors are checked by the per-evaluation parse before lowering; templates, directives, RegExp, names, property keys and helper arguments remain in the key.
keyCompleteness.realmAndFlags: One compiler instance per image surface and code storage; limits are fixed per instance; realms and template sites are runtime data reached through $global and the per-parse $script carrier.
keyCompleteness.notKeyed: Node spans (start/end) and node hashes are deliberately excluded from the key: they position nodes in one parse's text, and nothing in a shared entry reads them as data. Retained Function source text reaches the runtime only as an explicit helper argument (retainFunctionSource), so it stays in the key as a string literal that is never abstracted. The only effect of excluding spans is non-semantic: a shared entry's debug source ranges come from the first compiled parse.
keyCompleteness.keyedPositions: sourceStart (function/class retained-source start offsets) is a syntax field, not a span, and is keyed; it is conservative rather than required, since retained source travels as the explicit helper argument above.
keyCompleteness.exhaustiveness: packages/typescript/test/syntax-key.test.ts fails when any TypeNode, Expression or Statement kind in model.ts lacks an encoder case in key.ts (a missing case would key that kind by its tag alone).
